column2: #Conclusion: The results show that men typically spend more time outdoors than women do on work/school days. There's a considerable amount of men who spend up to 8 hours (around 480 minutes) outdoors. On average, men spend 162 minutes (estimate1) outdoors while women spend around 75 minutes (estimate2). The difference on time spent by the two groups is 87 minutes (estimate). The 90% confidence interval for the population mean is from 80.6 to 93.4 minutes.
